name: core-search-vectors
description: Search's vectors: an outside embedder pulls the instances whose text has no vector (staleEmbeddings) and settles their vectors (settleEmbeddings), which skips an instance whose text moved since and refuses a vector the config's dimensions or a 32-bit float cannot hold, with no event; a search by vector ranks by cosine and one by a query and a vector fuses the two rankings by reciprocal rank; similar leaves the instance out, and ranks a draft's text and vector the same way; a search across schemas skips one the caller may not read; a version that changes the model, the dimensions or the fields makes every vector stale; and the HTTP route and the MCP tool of the search across schemas.

s14.useWhen: Use to make a namespace for a new project: it starts with no schemas of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself.
s14.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to make a schema; call define_schema in the namespace. Do not use for a name that is a namespace already, archived or not: the create is refused (conflict).
s14.success: Returns the namespace, active, with who made it and when.

s15.useWhen: Use when a project made with create_namespace is finished: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, every write is refused (namespace_archived), and its reactions and schedules stop.
s15.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on a namespace the engine's options configure, which is refused (conflict), or to remove data: nothing is removed.
s15.success: Returns the namespace, archived, with who archived it and when; archiving an archived namespace changes nothing.

tools.name: engine.listSchemas
tools.title: List schemas

mcp.name: List schemas
mcp.description: Lists the schemas this namespace reaches, its own and the shared namespace's, with each one's live version and whether it has a draft.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to learn which schemas this namespace reaches and which of them have a live version.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's fields or operations; call describe_schema.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns each schema's name, its live version and whether it has a draft.

guidance.useWhen: Use to learn which schemas this namespace reaches and which of them have a live version.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's fields or operations; call describe_schema.

tools.title: Describe a schema

mcp.name: Describe a schema
mcp.description: Returns a schema's describe document: how a UI shows an instance (its display, and each field's title and icon), the JSON Schema of an instance, the behaviors its type composes with their config, and every operation with its parameters, its result and its tool.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use before calling a schema's tools: it gives the JSON Schema of an instance, each behavior with its config and summary, and each operation with its parameters, result and guidance.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read instances; call the schema's get or list.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the describe document of the live version.

guidance.useWhen: Use before calling a schema's tools: it gives the JSON Schema of an instance, each behavior with its config and summary, and each operation with its parameters, result and guidance.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read instances; call the schema's get or list.
guidance.success: Returns the describe document of the live version.

tools.description: Returns a schema's describe document: how a UI shows an instance (its display, and each field's title and icon), the JSON Schema of an instance, the behaviors its type composes with their config, and every operation with its parameters, its result and its tool.

tools.name: engine.defineSchema
tools.title: Define a schema draft

mcp.name: Define a schema draft
mcp.description: Stores a schema-file document (the form superschematic format --to=json writes) as the draft of its name, replacing the draft before it. It does not publish: a draft goes live only through the HTTP publish route.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to store a schema-file document as the draft of its name, replacing the draft before it.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to publish: a draft goes live only through the HTTP publish route.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the draft, with its name and hash; the live version is unchanged.

guidance.useWhen: Use to store a schema-file document as the draft of its name, replacing the draft before it.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to publish: a draft goes live only through the HTTP publish route.
guidance.success: Returns the draft, with its name and hash; the live version is unchanged.

document.description: The schema-file document: kind General, a name, and the types; superschematic format --to=json writes it

tools.name: engine.listBehaviors
tools.title: List behaviors

mcp.name: List behaviors
mcp.description: Lists the behaviors this engine runs, which a schema's types may compose: each one's name and description, the behaviors it requires and conflicts with, and the fields and operations it adds.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use before composing behaviors in a draft, to learn which behaviors this engine runs.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's config of its behaviors; call describe_schema.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns each behavior's name, description, requirements, conflicts, fields and operations.

guidance.useWhen: Use before composing behaviors in a draft, to learn which behaviors this engine runs.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's config of its behaviors; call describe_schema.
guidance.success: Returns each behavior's name, description, requirements, conflicts, fields and operations.

tools.description: Lists the behaviors this engine runs, which a schema's types may compose: each one's name and description, the behaviors it requires and conflicts with, and the fields and operations it adds.

tools.name: engine.describeBehavior
tools.title: Describe a behavior

mcp.name: Describe a behavior
mcp.description: Returns a behavior's declaration: the JSON Schema of the config a type gives it, of the parameters a create gives it and of the entry a write's preconditions carry for it, the behaviors it requires and conflicts with, its fields, its operations with their scope, parameters, result and invocation policy, and the codes its vetoes carry.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to learn what a behavior takes before composing it: its config, its create parameters, its preconditions and the codes its vetoes carry.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's config of the behavior; call describe_schema.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the behavior's declaration, with its defaults filled in.

guidance.useWhen: Use to learn what a behavior takes before composing it: its config, its create parameters, its preconditions and the codes its vetoes carry.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's config of the behavior; call describe_schema.
guidance.success: Returns the behavior's declaration, with its defaults filled in.

tools.description: Returns a behavior's declaration: the JSON Schema of the config a type gives it, of the parameters a create gives it and of the entry a write's preconditions carry for it, the behaviors it requires and conflicts with, its fields, its operations with their scope, parameters, result and invocation policy, and the codes its vetoes carry.

tools.name: engine.getValue
tools.title: Get a stored value

mcp.name: Get a stored value
mcp.description: Returns a value the engine stores by its hash, { hash, bytes, value }: a field whose JSON is longer than the engine's threshold, which an event (and an instance read with valueRefs) carries as a ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }. The caller must be able to read a schema of this namespace whose instances, events or behaviors hold the value.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read a large field an event, or an instance read with valueRefs, carries as a ref ({ "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }), by its hash.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read an instance; call its schema's get, which returns every field inline unless valueRefs asks for refs.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the value with its hash and its size in bytes.

guidance.useWhen: Use to read a large field an event, or an instance read with valueRefs, carries as a ref ({ "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }), by its hash.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read an instance; call its schema's get, which returns every field inline unless valueRefs asks for refs.
guidance.success: Returns the value with its hash and its size in bytes.

tools.description: Returns a value the engine stores by its hash, { hash, bytes, value }: a field whose JSON is longer than the engine's threshold, which an event (and an instance read with valueRefs) carries as a ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }. The caller must be able to read a schema of this namespace whose instances, events or behaviors hold the value.

hash.description: The value's hash: the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON, as a ref's $value holds it

returns.description: The value, with its hash and its canonical JSON's length in bytes

tools.name: engine.listNamespaces
tools.title: List namespaces

mcp.name: List namespaces
mcp.description: Lists the namespaces the caller may see: each one's name, whether the engine's options configure it or a create made it, whether it is the shared namespace, and whether it is archived.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to learn which namespaces you may see, and whether each is archived.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to list a namespace's schemas; call list_schemas.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns each namespace's name, origin (configured by the engine's options, or created), whether it is the shared namespace, and its state (active or archived).

guidance.useWhen: Use to learn which namespaces you may see, and whether each is archived.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to list a namespace's schemas; call list_schemas.
guidance.success: Returns each namespace's name, origin (configured by the engine's options, or created), whether it is the shared namespace, and its state (active or archived).

tools.description: Lists the namespaces the caller may see: each one's name, whether the engine's options configure it or a create made it, whether it is the shared namespace, and whether it is archived.

tools.name: engine.createNamespace
tools.title: Create a namespace

mcp.name: Create a namespace
mcp.description: Creates a namespace, which holds schemas and instances of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself. Its name is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

tools.description: Creates a namespace, which holds schemas and instances of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself. Its name is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

tools.name: engine.archiveNamespace
tools.title: Archive a namespace

mcp.name: Archive a namespace
mcp.description: Archives a namespace a create made: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, and it refuses every write, and runs no reaction or schedule, until it is unarchived.

tools.description: Archives a namespace a create made: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, and it refuses every write, and runs no reaction or schedule, until it is unarchived.

tools.name: engine.unarchiveNamespace
tools.title: Unarchive a namespace

mcp.name: Unarchive a namespace
mcp.description: Lets an archived namespace be written again; its reactions and schedules pick up where they stopped.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to write again to an archived namespace.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on an active namespace, which stays as it is.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the namespace, active; its reactions and schedules pick up where they stopped.

guidance.useWhen: Use to write again to an archived namespace.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on an active namespace, which stays as it is.
guidance.success: Returns the namespace, active; its reactions and schedules pick up where they stopped.

tools.description: Lets an archived namespace be written again; its reactions and schedules pick up where they stopped.
